# Close wrap, Fri 2026-11-06

**Partial bounce after Thursday's rout.** S&P +0.31% to 7,376.86, Nasdaq +1.09% to 24,579.42, Dow −0.46% to 51,285.73. SOX recovered ~6%+ after −12% Thu. Hot October jobs (+165k vs ~59–65k; UE 4.1%) kept December hike odds firm, but chips bounced off oversold levels ([Fox Business](https://www.foxbusiness.com/markets/stocks-11-6-2026); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/06/jobs-report-october-2026.html)).

**Movers:** AMD +11% to $449, INTC +7.7%, MU +5.1%, NVDA +2.8% (still group-avoid through 11/10). HUM +5.2% to $433.74 on beat/raise. ABNB +11.7% to $189.99 held after gap. TEAM −16% soft FY guide; DKNG −21% miss/cut outlook ([Proactive](https://www.proactiveinvestors.com/companies/news/1101382/market-movers-airbnb-moderna-cloudflare-firefly-aerospace-1101382.html)).

**Macro:** UMich prelim 51.0 vs ~48; 1-yr inflation 4.3% from 4.7%; AI-bubble chatter in comments ([UMich](https://www.sca.isr.umich.edu/)).

**Week scorecard (Nov 2–6):** 3 up / 9 down, avg −1.88% vs SPY −3.17% (Mon open→Fri close). Wins: HUM +4.5%, PLNT +3.9%, CPAY +1.8%. Losers: CI −7.7%, CDW −7.0%, RVTY −5.1% (logged into Thu crush). Paper swing −4.2% week vs bench −2.9%; day desk flat. Lesson: don't log new longs into a −4% tape.

**Next:** CPI Tue 11/10 8:30; TTD/HIMS/RKLB AMC Mon. AI-hardware avoids hold through 11/10.

## Swing ideas
- **ABNB** long, low. Q3 beat, FY growth to high teens, $12B buyback; +11.7% close after >5% gap (logged at close) ([Airbnb](https://news.airbnb.com/airbnb-q3-2026-financial-results)). Risk: travel/macro; first green day after gap.
- **HUM** long, med. Hold: FY adj EPS raised to ≥$9.50; +5.2% today ([Humana](https://humana.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/humana-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-raises-full)). Risk: Star Ratings; MA costs / Dem policy.
